## Motivation With `--hicache-write-policy write_back`, the device-eviction walk in `UnifiedRadixCache` copies each victim to host and blocks on that copy before taking the next victim. Each wait sits behind the write fence, so once the host pool is full the scheduler stalls once per victim while the GPU idles. This PR queues the walk's copies, submits them together, waits once, then demotes the victims in walk order. Eviction decisions are unchanged: same victims, same order, in both tree cores. ## Speed Tests and Profiling One GB300, `--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-write-policy write_back --hicache-size 100`, `benchmark/hicache/bench_multiturn.py`. The device pool holds ~1/4 of the history and the host pool all of it, so admissions evict but nothing is dropped. Mean (min-max), arms alternated, fresh server per run. | | main | this PR | | |---|---|---|---| | `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, eviction-bound: req/s (5 runs) | 113.0 (109.0-115.6) | 120.5 (117.8-122.4) | +6.6% | | TTFT p50 / p99 (ms) | 366 / 813 | 308 / 559 | -16% / -31% | | blocking D->H waits per eviction pass | 3.78 | 0.91 | -76% | | cache hit rate | 0.874 | 0.874 | same | | `Qwen/Qwen3-8B` (full attention), eviction-bound: req/s (3 runs) | 83.7 | 86.2 | +3.1%, within noise | | `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, no eviction: req/s (3 runs) | 150.6 | 149.5 | neutral | The gain grows with victims per eviction pass (3.8 for gpt-oss-20b, 2.5 for Qwen3-8B). The first copy of each pass still waits for the in-flight forward; batching cannot remove that.
Reproduce on one GPU (run each checkout twice, compare the second runs) ```bash #!/bin/bash # One arm of the HiCache write_back eviction A/B on one GPU. Run it from an sglang checkout of # main, then from the PR checkout (same GPU, nothing else on it), and compare the printed lines. # A checkout's first server JIT-compiles kernels and runs slower: run each arm twice, compare second runs. # bash run_ab.sh main; bash run_ab.sh main; git checkout ; bash run_ab.sh pr; bash run_ab.sh pr # Defaults reproduce config G (gpt-oss-20b, device pool ~1/4 of the sessions' history, host pool holds # all of it). Env overrides: MODEL, PORT, DEVICE_TOKENS, HOST_GB, BENCH_ARGS. set -euo pipefail LABEL=${1:?usage: run_ab.sh

+        unbacked, pinned = iter(batch_seqs(1)), iter(batch_seqs(2))
+        pinned_seqs, locks = [], []

+                insert_seq(cache, allocator, seq)
+                if is_pinned:
+                    node = match_seq(cache, seq).last_device_node
+                    self.assertTrue(cache.backup_node_for_write_back(node))

+class _Session:
+    def __init__(self, sid: int, rng: random.Random, now: int):

+def _tree_residency(tree_core) -> frozenset:
+    """Every node's key path and which tiers hold its component values."""
+    nodes = []
+    stack = [(tree_core.root_node, ())]
+    while stack:
+        node, path = stack.pop()
+        for child in node.children.values():
+            child_path = path + tuple(child.key.token_ids)
+            nodes.append(
+                (child_path,)

+                        child.component_data[ct].host_value is not None,
